# Does a planner.pick prompt that names catalysts raise evolutions by 2:30?

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Status | done |
| Area | models |
| Result | refuted |
| Created | L1.I10 |
| Updated | L2.I9 |

## Hypothesis

A planner.pick template that tells the planner to take the catalyst for any weapon at level 6 or higher (and recipe parts that complete an evolution) before new weapons makes evolutions land earlier than the default pick text.

## Method

Gym seeker-nm1-100s (seeker-sprouts 5/8 at 1:40), 200 s, default pick against a catalyst-first pick, knobs on in both. Read whether Fertilizer is offered and taken, evolution time, chests and damage. One game per arm, so a lead; repeat on another gym or fresh seeds if it moves.

## Findings

L2.I7 gym: catalyst-first pick got Overgrowth at 111 s against 227 s (one game each). L2.I8 from 0:00 on seeds 31-34 with the playbook knobs: lived 1 of 4 (died 2:08, 3:02, 2:32; seed 34 lived 5:00), against 3 of 4 for knobs alone. The deaths had 0-1 chests, so Fertilizer was rarely the limit. Seed 32 took it twice but seeker-sprouts stayed at 5/8. The pick text does not beat the default from 0:00. Chests are the limit, tested next in chest-first-goal.
